hook.name: SPCXReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single SPCX/TOKEN pool that intercepts exact-input swaps: on buys (SPCX→TOKEN) it takes a 2% SPCX fee split between a developer address and holder rewards; on sells (TOKEN→SPCX) it burns 0.5% of TOKEN input. Only one liquidity position is ever permitted, and exact-output swaps are rejected.
